children: Brazil's Planning Minister Bruno Moretti said on Monday the government expects to post a primary surplus of nearly 19 billion reais ($3.7 billion) in 2027, adding that mandatory spending growth will slow next year.
Moretti spoke at an event hosted by BTG Pactual ahead of the release of the government's 2027 budget bill, which is due to be submitted to Congress later on Monday.
